frozen_criteria.description: Reservoir current gas mass (Mg) is calculated by subtracting the produced gas mass from the initial gas mass.
The formula for current gas mass (Mg) is Mg = Initial gas mass - Produced gas mass.
Evidence grounding: The calculation is based on the conservation of mass principle in gas material balance, where the initial mass minus the produced mass gives the remaining mass in the reservoir.
